mina: Holding the cut — deploy-bot aborted promote, canary e2e failed due to auth-mock handshake timeouts.

deploy-bot: [automated] promote aborted: canary e2e failed (auth-mock: handshake timeout). see job 5932.

tom: I dug into the canary logs. The auth-mock started rejecting TLS during the upstream cert rotation yesterday, SNI sometimes fails and triggers a timeout.

qa-lead: I reproduced this locally with cert-rotation=true. Quick mitigation: increase handshake retry and client timeout in the mock config, tests pass.

mina: Options: pin to last-good sha and manual promote, patch mock config and rebuild canary, or abort the cut. Change window in ~40m.

release-coordinator: If the config tweak is small, patch+rebuild so we keep automated promote. Keep pin as fallback.

tom: Opening hotfix branch now: hotfix/auth-mock-retry. Triggering CI with increased handshake retries (3 -> 5) and longer client timeout.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered by @tom. polling for canary results...

tom: Canary e2e passed on rebuild. All green.

deploy-bot: promote triggered by @tom. attempting promote... promote succeeded: release-2026-03-23 -> production. :tada:

mina: Great work, unblocked the cut. Please add infra note: auth-mock flake caused by cert rotation; hotfix applied. Follow-up ticket INF-7321.

release-coordinator: Note added and INF-7321 created. Closing hold. :white_check_mark:
